clips.label: Broad camera sweep
clips.details:
The wave comes closer and the horizon tilts. The first 5.5 seconds are strongest. Later framing becomes cramped and reflected edge patterns are visible.

All three start from the same porcelain wave. Opening, prompts, noise curve, seed sequence, repaint timing and sampler are identical; only spatial motion changes. Recurrent Krea Turbo, three Euler intervals, CFG1, two paintings per second, Lanczos and RIFE 4.25 at 24 fps. Reflected borders and interpolation artifacts remain; these are motion studies, not polished films.

clips.label: Travelling twist
clips.note: Wave turns upright → folds aside → cranes
clips.details:
Localized twist centres change over time. The strongest change in composition of these three; a larger crane appears around 9 seconds. Some double edges and smearing remain in that transition.

clips.label: Elastic travelling wave
clips.note: Different image bands slide back and forth
clips.details:
Direct horizontal wave deformation under the same repaint recipe. The 5–7 second section is clearest. Severe ghosting occurs around 8.6–8.9 seconds, and the ending has stretched/repeated borders.
